title: 1 month of progress using claude, unity, blender, and begrudgingly - meshy lol. Would love beta testers.
author: No_Departure7494
selftext: Laggy right now due to the editor and AI movements. A terrible pain that I am slowly optimizing. Not the small ships or vehicles, infantry off screen.

comments.author: FisterMister22
comments.body: Cool as a hobby project but a long way from being finished, keep up!

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body: Thanks. I am open to all criticism. What would you change in this clip? I have worked tirelessly on the graphics and either A. I don't know what ask for or B. the ceiling has been reached, because I cannot get it to look much better than this.

replies.author: DalleyGamesOfficial
replies.body: Study games that you like by looking up their rendering pipeline. Then apply it. I focus on one thing at a time. For instance: lighting.

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body: Can you tell me what looks off about the lighting? I have struggled with it. When I switched to using a real sun it looked far better.
